messages:
jamie: Heads up — noticed a pileup during last deploy: ArgoCD prune jobs are queuing and several HelmReleases in eu-west are reporting "unable to acquire lock". GPU pool scale-up is delayed because nodes are stuck in Pending from the cloud provider.
infra-bot: Incident detected: argocd-prune-queue > 150s, affected clusters: eu-west-1, eu-central-2. Alerts: argo.sync.queue.length, helmrelease.lock.errors. See /alerts/1969001234
vikram: is this during the nightly batch or the canary rollout? any recent gitops changes?
jamie: Canary. We pushed a large app-of-apps change that fanout-adds ~40 apps, several include helmreleases that run post-install hooks. Prune wave started and then these hooks blocked finalizers.
sofia: grabbing argocd logs now — attaching snippet of the last 20 lines:
```
2026-03-17T02:14:12Z argocd-server INFO sync: app-of-apps sync started
2026-03-17T02:14:14Z repo-server WARN helmrelease/ai-dataplane failed lock: attempt 1
2026-03-17T02:14:30Z repo-server ERROR prune: object finalizer stuck: job/cleanup-xyz
2026-03-17T02:15:00Z controller WARN prune-queue backlog=87
```
sofia: also seeing cloud provider API 429s when creating instances for gpu-pool-eu-west.
alex: quick mitigation: pause the app-of-apps sync and manually scale gpu-pool to desired size? or temporarily increase argocd-controller concurrency flags: `--prune-workers` and `--app-controller-reconcile-rate`? Could also set `spec.syncOptions: ["PrunePropagationPolicy=foreground"]` for affected apps to help finalizers run earlier.
vikram: we should avoid changing controller flags in prod without QA. Manual pause + sequential unpause might be safer: reduce fanout to batches of 5.
jamie: Agreed. Plan: 1) Pause app-of-apps in eu-west 2) Manually trigger helmrelease reconciles in small batches 3) Watch cloud API error rate and backoff. I'll start the pause.
ops-oncall: pausing now — `argocd app pause app-of-apps-eu-west` :white_check_mark:
sofia: after pausing, prune backlog dropped from 87 -> 12 in ~2m. Some jobs still stuck due to `job` finalizer. Suggest running `kubectl delete job cleanup-xyz --namespace infra --wait=false` for those known dead jobs.
alex: if we have automation, update our GitOps preflight to: check for concurrent helm hooks + limit app-of-apps fanout to X by default. Also add a cooldown when cloud API 429s spike: fail fast and queue retries.
jamie: created a postmortem stub and action items: pause-on-high-prune, add preflight hook, add a guard in terraform to avoid launching >10 GPU nodes per AZ in a single operation. Posting link: https://redwood.internal/pm/INC-1969001234
vikram: follow-up: can we add a temporary pipeline to bundle heavy helmrelease changes behind a feature flag so we avoid simultaneous hook spikes?
sofia: yes — I'll prototype a `helm-hook-cost-estimate` check that warns on >5 hooks in parallel.
ops-oncall: marking incident resolved for now. reopening if prune queue > 50 again. :thumbsup:
jamie: thanks all — will open PRs for the preflight and guard rails and tag infra for review.
